page.overview:
What is Mutants?

Religious-related names: Demons demon-spawns

Other Binomial names: Homo detritus Homo inferior Homo Killcrop Homo mutandis (on Earth-889) Homo mutatis (on Earth-4935 and Earth-58163) Homo sapiens superior Homo superior

At the forefront of mutant politics are the X-Men, a team of mutants founded by Professor Charles Xavier, who dreams of a peaceful coexistence between humans and mutants, coming into conflict against mutant extremists like Magneto and Apocalypse. However, mutants are under constant threat from endless anti-mutant, pro-human hate groups and their ruthless machines, most notably the Sentinels. Over the years, a number of atrocities have been committed against mutantkind, such as the genocide on the mutant nation of Genosha and being driven to the brink of extinction on M-Day. Recently, there was a second attempt at a mutant nation on the island of Krakoa, but it too fell due to the relentless bigotry of humanity, though mutantkind nevertheless endures.

In addition, there are less than 1 million Arakkii mutants on the planet Arakko, while another 1 million Arakkii had left the planet to become mercenaries.

Also known as: Homo superior, Mutantkind.
